facts.text: UW-Stevens Point provides a textbook rental library system where undergraduate students check out course books and return them at term end, with rental fees included in tuition.

sources.title: Enrollment Appointment Times - Office of the Registrar
sources.quote: Text Rental is a unique service available to undergraduate students at UWSP. It is a rental library system where students check out most of their course books and return them at the end of the term.
